hub.title: Stories about fights and making up: real situations
hub.desc: A husband who goes quiet, a neighbor who doesn't, a friend who's hurt, a coworker who dumps work on you. What's behind each fight and how to start talking.
hub.lead: Not just couples: neighbors, friends, coworkers, parents. What sits behind each fight and the line to open the conversation with. Any of them you can work through with Mediator: you tell your side, the other person tells theirs, and the bot helps you hear each other.
